reason: I like the creator and the bottle looks nice, but my tap water is fine and I already have a Brita at home. Paying almost $68 today and then signing up for a filter subscription is a lot for something I don't really need.
objection: I already filter my water at home, so this is a second filter system I'd have to keep paying for. $40 to $50 for the bottle plus filters every couple of months adds up on my budget.
would_change_my_mind: If the bottle alone was around $30 with free shipping and no subscription, I'd probably grab it with the creator's code as an impulse buy.
